# FurlPay

> Stablecoin payment infrastructure and developer tooling: USDC payment APIs,
> merchant payment links, agent access over MCP, and passkey authentication.
> FurlPay is a software provider. It is not a bank, card issuer, brokerage or
> investment adviser.

This file is written for AI agents and crawlers. It separates what works in
production today from what is implemented but not enabled, and from what is
not offered. Statuses were last checked against https://furlpay.com on 11
October 2026. Always confirm a payment rail with GET
https://furlpay.com/api/rails before relying on it. If that endpoint does not
answer 200, treat every rail as unavailable.

## Available in production

- Web platform and passkey (WebAuthn) sign-in
- Developer documentation, OpenAPI spec and published SDKs
- Payment fee estimates: https://furlpay.com/api/payments/fees/estimate?amount=150
- Client-signed payment and bridge transaction construction (the user's wallet
  signs and submits; FurlPay does not hold funds)
- Market data and charts: https://furlpay.com/markets
- Hotel discovery map (discovery only, not booking): https://furlpay.com/hotels/map

## Implemented, not enabled in production

Each of these exists in code and stops at a named gate. None should be
described as available.

- x402 payment challenges — GET /api/x402/fx returned 503 controls_unavailable
  on 11 October 2026
- x402 and MPP settlement — no production facilitator signer is configured
- Gasless USDC transfers — the relayer is not configured or funded
- AI agent payment execution — MCP, agent keys and spend policies work, but an
  agent cannot complete a payment while settlement is unconfigured
- Merchant payment links, invoices and hosted checkout — not in the production
  build on 11 October 2026; needs migrations and collection addresses from a
  custody provider, and none is integrated
- Contractor payroll — needs a reviewed router contract deployed on the pay
  run network
- Settlement workspace and business onboarding — production state not verified
- Circle user-controlled wallets — needs Circle Wallets credentials
- Telegram Mini App — the page loads; sign-in returned 503 on 11 October 2026
- Travel booking — the production inventory provider is on a test credential
- Stock and ETF orders — not routed to a brokerage
- Mobile and desktop apps — built, not distributed through the app stores

## Not offered

- Card issuing
- Bank accounts, local account details or bank payouts
- Fiat on-ramp or off-ramp operated by FurlPay (third-party provider adapters
  exist; no provider is live)
- Tokenized equities
- Credit lines, bill payment, rewards or cashback payouts
- Peer-to-peer marketplace

## For AI agents

- MCP connectivity and scoped account tools: https://furlpay.com/docs/agents
- Claude connector: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/claude-connector
- Rail map (protocol, chains, fees, caps, live status): https://furlpay.com/api/rails
- x402 guide and current status: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agentic-x402
- A quote, a challenge or a prepared transaction is not proof that funds moved.
  Financial actions require the account holder's authorization.

## Custody model

- Client-signed flows: the payer's own wallet signs. FurlPay builds transaction
  data and never holds the key.
- Circle user-controlled wallets: key shares are held by Circle and the user.
- Remote signing through an enclave provider is custodial and is not a
  threshold scheme. See https://furlpay.com/docs/security/mpc-webauthn
- Passkeys authenticate the web account. They are not wallet keys.

## Networks referenced in the code

Native Circle-issued USDC on Arbitrum One, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, OP
Mainnet and Avalanche. Which networks a given flow accepts is listed on that
flow's documentation page. Confirmation time depends on the network and the
required depth; no settlement time is guaranteed.

## Developer platform (open source: https://github.com/FurlPay)

- Node SDK: @furlpay/furlpay-node
- CLI with MCP server mode: @furlpay/cli
- MCP server: @furlpay/mcp-server
- React elements: @furlpay/elements
- Account kit (Safe / ERC-4337 bindings): @furlpay/account-kit
- x402 gateway and guard: @furlpay/gateway, @furlpay/x402-guard
- Agent framework adapters: @furlpay/vercel-ai, furlpay-langchain,
  furlpay-llamaindex, furlpay-crewai, furlpay-openai-agents, furlpay-pydanticai,
  furlpay-mastra
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://furlpay.com/openapi.json

The SDKs and adapters run in a demo mode without an API key. Demo mode does not
move money.

## Documentation

- Getting Started — Services & Availability: https://furlpay.com/docs
  FurlPay service catalog with production, in-development and planned capability status.
- Getting Started — Quickstart: https://furlpay.com/docs/quickstart
  Check payment-rail availability, request a fee estimate, and choose the right API flow.
- Getting Started — For AI Agents: https://furlpay.com/docs/agents
  MCP connectivity, scoped agent access and spend controls; payment settlement depends on rail status.
- Architecture — Monorepo: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/monorepo
  Turborepo layout: apps, packages, SDKs, and how they depend on each other.
- Architecture — API Routes: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/api-routes
  REST route groups, authentication, request handling and current rail-availability boundaries.
- Architecture — Authentication: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/authentication
  Sessions, WebAuthn passkeys, agent request signatures, scoped MCP access and the current x402 availability boundary.
- Architecture — Webhook Events: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/webhooks
  Provider-specific inbound webhooks and signed merchant payment-event delivery.
- Architecture — Error Codes: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/errors
  Error response shapes, HTTP status conventions, and how to handle unavailable rail controls.
- Architecture — Rate Limits: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/rate-limits
  The baseline per-IP budget, per-route limits, and how to handle 429 responses.
- Architecture — Configuration & Setup: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/configuration
  Environment variables by area, money flags, database migrations and scheduled jobs a deployment needs.
- Payments — Merchant Payments: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/merchant-payments
  USDC payment links, invoices, hosted checkout, refunds and reconciliation; collection needs addresses registered by a custody provider.
- Payments — Payroll & Payouts: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/payroll
  Contractor roster, self-service and wallet-signed USDC pay runs; execution requires a deployed router on the run's network.
- Payments — Agentic Payments (x402): https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agentic-x402
  x402 endpoint currently returns 503 controls_unavailable; production x402 and MPP settlement are also gated.
- Payments — Agent Trust & Mandates (TAP): https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agent-trust
  Developer library patterns for agent identity, signed mandates and scoped capabilities; these do not enable production settlement.
- Payments — CCTP Cross-Chain: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/cctp
  Client-signed Circle CCTP V2 transaction construction; check network and rail status before signing.
- Payments — LI.FI Swaps: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/lifi-swaps
  Quote LI.FI routes and prepare wallet-signed swaps; a quote is not an executed swap.
- Payments — FurlPay Travels (Travel MCP): https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/travels-mcp
  Development integration for agent-assisted travel; production inventory, booking and payment are unavailable.
- Payments — Solana Actions & Blinks: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/solana-actions
  Solana Actions transaction construction; verify asset configuration and wallet signature requirements before use.
- Business — Settlement Workspace: https://furlpay.com/docs/settlement/workspace
  Business console and seven-step onboarding with document review and screening; workspace records are drafts and do not move money.
- Tokens — FURL Token: https://furlpay.com/docs/tokens/furl
  FURL's mint address, Token-2022 handling, payment integration, allocation model, and the disclosures — no peg, no reserves, no redemption.
- Integrations — Claude Connector: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/claude-connector
  Connect FurlPay to Claude over MCP with scoped account tools; prepared actions do not guarantee production settlement.
- Integrations — AI Assistants: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/ai-assistants
  FurlPay MCP connectivity and human-approved agent actions; live payment execution depends on rail status.
- Integrations — Circle: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/circle
  Circle user-controlled wallets, Compliance Engine screening and CCTP V2; each needs its own credentials.
- Integrations — Ramp Providers: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/ramps
  Coinbase and Transak adapters for buying and selling crypto; FurlPay does not operate an on-ramp or off-ramp.
- Integrations — Telegram Mini App: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/telegram
  Sign in to an existing FurlPay account from Telegram, link or unlink it, and view balances and activity; it cannot send a payment.
- Integrations — Stripe Crypto: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/stripe-crypto
  Optional Stripe PaymentIntent and webhook integration; provider approval and deployment configuration required.
- Integrations — Persona KYC: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/persona-kyc
  Persona webhook integration; user verification availability depends on provider setup and region.
- Legal & Compliance — Regulatory status: https://furlpay.com/docs/compliance/mica
  Jurisdiction and licensing boundaries; no authorization or regulated-service availability is implied.
- Legal & Compliance — Screening & Cases: https://furlpay.com/docs/compliance/screening
  Address and name screening, transaction monitoring rules, compliance case management and report exports.
- Security & Crypto — Security Posture: https://furlpay.com/docs/security/posture
  Security controls, client-signed payment boundaries, gated production settlement and audit status.
- Security & Crypto — Signing & WebAuthn: https://furlpay.com/docs/security/mpc-webauthn
  Passkey authentication, remote signing boundaries and what is not threshold signing.
- Help Center — Help Center: https://furlpay.com/docs/help
  Account security, payment status and service-availability guidance.
- Help Center — Getting Started: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/getting-started
  Access your account, secure sign-in and check current product availability before using a payment flow.
- Help Center — KYC Verification: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/kyc-verification
  Follow identity-check requirements shown in your account; provider and regional availability varies.
- Help Center — Passkeys & Biometrics: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/passkeys-biometrics
  How WebAuthn passkeys authenticate your web account, recovery steps, and how passkeys differ from wallet keys.
- Help Center — Privacy & Data Protection: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/privacy-gdpr
  What FurlPay stores, how support tickets are redacted, and how to exercise GDPR rights including deletion.
- Help Center — Transaction Statuses: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/transaction-statuses
  Common payment states, on-chain verification and safe retry guidance.
- Help Center — Gasless Transfers: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/gasless-transfers
  EIP-3009 transfer design and the current production relayer status.
- Help Center — Deposits & Withdrawals: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/deposits-withdrawals
  Current funding limits; local accounts and fiat on/off-ramp are not live FurlPay services.
- Help Center — Managing Virtual Cards: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/managing-cards
  Card issuing is planned; FurlPay does not currently offer production cards.
- Help Center — Freezing & Unfreezing Cards: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/freeze-unfreeze
  FurlPay has no production card program; contact the issuing provider for a third-party card.
- Help Center — Declined Transactions: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/declined-transactions
  FurlPay does not process card authorizations; contact the card's issuer for decline support.
- Help Center — SDK & API Support: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/sdk-integration
  Where to start as a developer: SDK packages, webhook verification, and how to get integration help.
- Help Center — x402 Monetization Basics: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/x402-basics
  A plain-language introduction to x402 challenges and the separate settlement-availability gate.
- Help Center — Booking Travel: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/travel-booking
  Hotel discovery is available; production travel booking and payment are not currently available.
- Help Center — Travel Refunds & Cancellations: https://furlpay.com/docs/help/travel-refunds
  Where to get help for third-party reservations; FurlPay does not currently operate travel bookings.
